question.problem:
Suppose we want to measure the mass of an ant. Which of the following metric units could we use?

I. $\rm{m}$

II. $\rm{mg}$

III. $\rm{s}$
question.worked_solution:
A table showing the metric units of mass is given below.

| Name | Symbol |
| --- | --- |
| Kilogram | $\textrm{kg}$ |
| Gram | $\textrm{g}$ |
| Milligram | $\textrm{mg}$ |

Therefore, from the given options, the only unit of mass is $\textrm{mg}.$
